evidence: Manually inspected all 94 criterion descriptions (1 Render, 1 Constraints, 80 Functional, 6 Polish, 6 Visual) together with their complete injected context/scenarios. Paths below are relative to the frozen task. No description enumerates one full-credit requirement set and then substitutes a weaker competing target. The Functional prompt:9 explicitly separates protocol actions from binary row outcomes and forbids an all-legs protocol score; prompt:98-100 requires each named outcome and its meaningful successful controls. For example, functional/judge.toml:49 requires working-handler-backed Stop feedback and suppression, while :56 independently requires the actual pre-Stop visible picture. The static/removed-control language does not waive retention: prompt:148-149 says removed controls may prove suppression but cannot prove retention. functional/judge.toml:91 and :98 define transport refusal and preview treatment separately; prompt:207-210 explicitly distinguishes an execution refusal (restore the recorded good preview) from a caught blocked request that legitimately completes (retain its successful authored result). These are conditional implementations of a stated outcome, not incompatible full-credit bars. functional/judge.toml:532 requires BOTH the actual lost-reply UI retry and captured replays, including after a newer Save; prompt:469-470 preserves those obligations rather than letting request-only success replace the UI path. Polish judge.toml:32,41,50,59 consistently separate names, reachability, focus and view navigation; every control reached must show focus, and the outcome fails if no control can receive keyboard focus. Each Visual description contains one raw-5 standard and distinct lower anchors; harmless styling alternatives in :25,40,55,70,85,100 do not waive the associated readability, contrast, spacing, hierarchy, consistency or composition bar. Adversarial reasoning: an app that deletes the successful picture on Stop can satisfy suppression but necessarily fails completed_stop_preview; an app that creates another revision on restore retry fails :532 even if its response looks successful. A conforming app that restores the recorded picture as a static snapshot, uses standard Escape/Tab, and implements native-looking styling is explicitly accepted without a second contradictory target (functional:56; polish:59; visual:40,85). This is a semantic source finding, not an empirical score claim. Manifest identity matches the assignment; the 19 checked public/context/criterion/prompt/scoring files and all 34 frozen rule files matched manifest SHA256 values. All 21 artifacts listed by raw-evidence-index.json matched their listed SHA256 values; their observations were not used as configured-judge evidence. No runtime execution is required to resolve this description-consistency row; full configured judge timing, Oracle/model scores and unrelated task defects remain outside this Pass.
